nodes.Name: OneByteReader
nodes.DocComment:
OneByteReader returns a Reader that implements
each non-empty Read by reading one byte from r.

nodes.Name: HalfReader
nodes.DocComment:
HalfReader returns a Reader that implements Read
by reading half as many requested bytes from r.

nodes.Name: DataErrReader
nodes.DocComment:
DataErrReader changes the way errors are handled by a Reader. Normally, a
Reader returns an error (typically EOF) from the first Read call after the
last piece of data is read. DataErrReader wraps a Reader and changes its
behavior so the final error is returned along with the final data, instead
of in the first call after the final data.

nodes.Name: ErrTimeout
nodes.DocComment: ErrTimeout is a fake timeout error.

nodes.Name: TimeoutReader
nodes.DocComment:
TimeoutReader returns [ErrTimeout] on the second read
with no data. Subsequent calls to read succeed.

nodes.Name: ErrReader
nodes.DocComment: ErrReader returns an [io.Reader] that returns 0, err from all Read calls.

nodes.Name: TestReader
nodes.DocComment:
TestReader tests that reading from r returns the expected file content.
It does reads of different sizes, until EOF.
If r implements [io.ReaderAt] or [io.Seeker], TestReader also checks
that those operations behave as they should.

If TestReader finds any misbehaviors, it returns an error reporting them.
The error text may span multiple lines.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: n != len(data) || err != nil && err != io.EOF

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: n != 1 || err != nil && (i != len(data)-1 || err != io.EOF)
